decisions.reason: This recruitment service is far from the firm’s established warehousing and transport-support knowledge base, so under an absorptive-capacity view the firm is less able to read early market signals, improve the offer, and justify continued commitment.

Although still outside the core business, superyacht crew recruitment is closer to the firm’s transport and maritime-support knowledge, giving it a better chance to learn, build useful networks, and refine the service commercially.
